about: Real client reviews only, added by the owner (never written or edited by the autopilot). Each review needs the client's consent. Posts quote one with <Review id="..." />; /reviews lists them and goes live once there is at least one.

fields.name: client's name as they agreed to show it
fields.url: link to the client (their site or the public review)
fields.source: where it was given: email, Upwork, Google, WhatsApp...
